title: Bound the reclamation scheduling proxy worker's initial receive
outcome: The scheduling regression's worker cannot wait indefinitely if another Arc retains its request sender; timeout handling preserves the queue canary's negative and positive assertions.
acceptance: The proxy worker's initial queue wait is bounded by the existing DEADLOCK_GUARD without increasing timeouts or weakening the regression assertions.
Focused reclamation tests pass and an independent review confirms shutdown and unwind teardown remain bounded.
